summary: Exact candidate 26f1a21 is test-only ownership hardening, not a runtime fix. On both the prepared base and exact candidate, an inserted [A,B,C] checkpoint owned only at depth 3 is structurally split by the fresh-prefill [A,B] lookup but returns zero device indices. The candidate adds no runtime or native change and its passing regression explicitly asserts that unresolved result.

tests.what_was_measured: Actual MambaRadixCache on AMD Instinct MI355X: the original depth-3-only n-1 lookup returned 0 after a structural split; exact depth-2 and arbitrary depth-37 checkpoints returned 2 and 37 GPU indices matching independent torch.arange references; divergence before the first depth-64 checkpoint returned 0.
20 tests passed. The candidate's new short-prefix test passes by asserting device_indices.numel() == 0, so this is regression documentation rather than a fix.

The exact candidate reproduced every base measurement, including original_n_minus_1_count=0 and divergence_before_checkpoint_count=0. Source imports resolved to /job/repo/python/sglang and its mamba_radix_cache.py.

gpu_evidence: torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 reported AMD Instinct MI355X; cache indices and independent references were allocated on device cuda.
remaining_counterexamples: Insert [A,B,C] with its only complete Mamba state owned at depth 3, then match the fresh-prefill n-1 key [A,B]: the split node has no Mamba state and device_indices remains length 0.
Divergence before the first real recurrent checkpoint returns zero reusable indices even when attention KV structurally matches.
The candidate provides neither arbitrary-depth recurrent-plus-convolution checkpoint production nor an execution path that retains attention KV while replaying recurrent layers.
remaining_limitations: No hybrid Mamba model weights were available, so end-to-end cold/warm logits, logprobs, latency, and recurrent/convolution replay semantics remain unverified. The actual cache behavior and GPU-resident index handling were tested, but this does not qualify model execution. No source or native file changed in the candidate, so no native rebuild was applicable.
